**1082 hits across 94 files.** Most must stay.

Safe zone is JS variable names in `services/`. Four zones are frozen.

| zone | lines | why |
|---|---|---|
| [docs/openapi.yaml](docs/openapi.yaml), [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) | 6 | public API contract |
| [vendor/reporting-sdk/](vendor/reporting-sdk/src/client.js) | 12 | regenerated by `vendor:refresh` |
| [migrations/](migrations/20250114_create_accounts.sql) | 37 | applied in production |
| SQL text in `services/*/src/repo/*.js` | 125 | DB column is still `account_id` |

The repo layer is the trap. Params can rename. Query strings cannot.

Next: approve a JS-identifier-only rename, nothing wider.
